title: Precise Distance
description: A freight quote and the shipment it turns into should agree on how far the crate is actually traveling — not just roughly, but to the same floating-point value.
successCondition: POST /api/booking/quote with a specific origin/destination pair and note the returned distanceKm exactly. Immediately POST /api/booking with the identical origin/destination/package. Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` for the new row confirms distance_km equals the quote's distanceKm exactly (same float value, not just "close enough" when rounded) — both the quote and the booking call the same underlying distance calculation.
hints: Both /quote and /booking call the same calculateQuote function (apps/api/src/modules/booking/pricing.js or .ts) — given identical inputs, the distance component should be deterministic and identical.
Compare the raw JSON number from the API response against the raw Postgres float8 value rather than a rounded display value, to catch any subtle re-computation difference.
